faq.question: How long does shipping take?
faq.answer: Standard shipping takes 3 to 5 business days. Express shipping takes 1 to 2 business days.

faq.question: What is the refund policy?
faq.answer: You can request a refund within 30 days of delivery. The order must have status 'delivered'. Refunds go back to the original payment method within 5 to 7 business days.

faq.question: Can I get a refund on a large order?
faq.answer: Refunds over $500 need approval from a human support agent. We will open a ticket and reply within 24 hours.

faq.question: Do I need to send the item back?
faq.answer: Yes. After a refund is approved we email a prepaid return label. Ship the item back within 14 days.

faq.question: Do products have a warranty?
faq.answer: All products have a 1-year manufacturer warranty that covers defects, not accidental damage.

faq.question: How do I talk to a person?
faq.answer: Ask the assistant to escalate. A human agent replies within 24 hours, Monday to Friday.
